# The two npm commands (cli/) have their own lock file. "make check"
      # checks their code style and types, runs their tests and builds them.
      - name: Install the packages of the two npm commands
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
        working-directory: cli
├── cli/               the two npm commands: create-toraline-monorepo and update-toraline-monorepo
├── boilerplate/       the version of this boilerplate, the updates of each release, what the create command changes
| `cli/` | The code of the two npm commands. [cli/README.md](cli/README.md) has its commands and how to try a command on your machine |

| `boilerplate/` | `VERSION` (the version of this boilerplate), `updates/` (one file per release) and `create-manifest.json` (what `create-toraline-monorepo` changes in a copy). [docs/boilerplate-version.md](docs/boilerplate-version.md) |
| `.github/workflows/release.yml` | The workflow "Release", started by hand: it publishes the two commands to npm and creates the tag of the version. [docs/releasing.md](docs/releasing.md) |
| `docs/repositories.md` | The list of the repositories that were created from this boilerplate |

- `cli/`: the two npm commands of the boilerplate, `create-toraline-monorepo` and `update-toraline-monorepo` (TypeScript, no dependency at run time). It has its own `package.json` and lock file and is not in the npm workspace of the root. `make lint-cli`, `make test-cli` and `make build-cli` are part of `make check`. Read [cli/README.md](cli/README.md) before changing it. `boilerplate/` holds the version of the boilerplate (`boilerplate/VERSION`), one updates file per release, and `boilerplate/create-manifest.json`: the files and lines that the create command changes in a copy. When you rename or delete a file that the manifest names, or change a line that it replaces, `make test-cli` fails and names the entry to correct. The formats: [docs/boilerplate-version.md](docs/boilerplate-version.md). A person publishes the commands ([docs/releasing.md](docs/releasing.md)); an agent never runs `npm publish` and never creates a release tag.

# The two npm commands of the boilerplate (cli/): their targets are in
# cli/cli.mk, and "make check" runs them. A monorepo that was created from the
# boilerplate has no cli/ folder; this line then includes nothing.
-include cli/cli.mk
